name: @hangox/qoder-proxy
description: Anthropic Messages → Qoder 中国站 legacy 代理（Gate 1 Walking Skeleton）

scripts.build: bun build src/cli.ts --target bun --outfile dist/qoder-proxy.js --minify --banner '#!/usr/bin/env bun' && bun build src/statusline-runtime.ts --target bun --outfile dist/qoder-statusline-runtime.js --minify && bun build src/statusline-installer.ts --target bun --outfile dist/install-qoder-statusline.js --minify --banner '#!/usr/bin/env bun' && chmod 755 dist/qoder-proxy.js dist/qoder-statusline-runtime.js dist/install-qoder-statusline.js
scripts.test:pack: bun run build && bun run verify:package && bun scripts/pack-smoke.ts
scripts.prepack: bun run build && bun run verify:package
